sops.title: PI Source-Backed Drafting SOP
sops.description: Drafting runs fail closed: every legal proposition and draft paragraph must point to a source card or firm-private clause, and every output stays research-only until partner review.

review_gates.label: Partner review before client-facing output or court filing
Latest official form / legislation check before filing

blocks.title: Mall slip-and-fall breach wording
blocks.instruction: For mall slip-and-fall matters, preserve and plead the specific hazard, warning signage, cleaning/inspection system, CCTV, incident report, and witness trail before expressing any breach view.

blocks.title: CCTV preservation wording
blocks.instruction: Request immediate preservation of CCTV, incident reports, cleaning logs, inspection records, staff rosters, contractor records, and photographs for the relevant time window.

blocks.title: Schedule of damages house style
blocks.instruction: Separate general damages, special damages, earnings loss, future loss, care, medical expenses, equipment/accommodation, interest, deductions and missing proof. Each line item carries evidence status.

blocks.title: Medical evidence checklist
blocks.instruction: Before quantum drafting, check diagnosis, treatment, prognosis, incapacity period, pre-existing conditions, future care/treatment need and whether an expert report is required.
